categories.main_business_segments: Ningbo Jiangfeng Electronic Materials Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of ultra-high purity metal sputtering targets and semiconductor precision components. The sputtering targets include aluminum, titanium, tantalum, copper, and various ultra-high purity metal alloy targets used in semiconductor chip and flat panel display manufacturing. The semiconductor precision components cover metal, ceramic, and resin materials, serving semiconductor chip and display production equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as physical vapor deposition (PVD) for sputtering target production, with core capabilities in grain orientation control, welding, precision machining, and high-purity cleaning and packaging. It has developed proprietary technologies for large-size, high-density tungsten and tantalum targets, multi-layer titanium alloy diffusion welding, and micro-arc oxidation surface treatment for shower heads. The production involves complex processes including ultra-precision machining, diffusion welding, vacuum brazing, surface treatment, anodizing, plasma spraying, and super-cleaning.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global semiconductor manufacturers such as TSMC, SMIC, SK Hynix, UMC, and BOE. The products serve the semiconductor wafer manufacturing and chip packaging sectors, as well as semiconductor equipment manufacturers requiring precision components. The company’s markets cover advanced, mature, and specialty semiconductor process nodes, with applications in integrated circuits, flat panel displays, and solar cells.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Zhejiang Province and multiple subsidiaries across China including Beijing, Shanghai, Guangdong, Hunan, and Wuhan. It also has wholly-owned subsidiaries in Hong Kong, Singapore, Malaysia, and Japan, supporting global sales and technical services. The company actively pursues global market expansion, serving customers worldwide and establishing sales and service networks in Southeast Asia and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: Ningbo Jiangfeng Electronic Materials operates primarily upstream and midstream in the semiconductor supply chain, producing critical raw materials (ultra-high purity metal sputtering targets) and precision components used in semiconductor manufacturing equipment. It controls the supply chain from raw material procurement through to finished product delivery, including vertical integration of raw material sourcing and in-house manufacturing of key production equipment.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous technological innovation and R&D investment, focusing on breakthroughs in ultra-high purity metal materials, sputtering target manufacturing, and semiconductor precision components. It invests in developing large-size, high-density targets, multi-layer titanium alloy welding, and advanced surface treatment technologies. The company also prioritizes building a globalized R&D and production system, enhancing equipment capabilities, and expanding product lines to cover advanced semiconductor process nodes and precision parts for core semiconductor equipment.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of ultra-high purity metal sputtering targets and semiconductor precision components to semiconductor manufacturers and equipment makers. The company employs a customized production model based on client orders, with sales conducted mainly via direct sales and some agency sales through trading companies, especially in Japan. Revenue recognition follows delivery and customer acceptance, with contracts specifying product specifications and delivery schedules.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in the ultra-high purity metal sputtering target industry, competing globally with multinational corporations from the US and Japan. It has successfully broken the import dependency in China and holds a significant market share worldwide. In semiconductor precision components, it is rapidly expanding and becoming a core supplier to major domestic and international semiconductor equipment manufacturers, leveraging its technology and customer base from the sputtering target business.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.6 billion, representing a 38.57% year-over-year increase, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 400.56 million, up 56.79%. The semiconductor sputtering target segment accounted for about 64.7% of revenue, while precision components contributed 24.6%, growing 55.53% year-over-year. The company’s total assets reached RMB 8.69 billion, growing 38.55% from the previous year, reflecting strong growth and expansion in production capacity and R&D investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers highly customized, ultra-high purity metal sputtering targets and precision components with superior quality, stability, and advanced technological features meeting stringent semiconductor manufacturing requirements. It emphasizes comprehensive quality control, advanced manufacturing equipment, and strong R&D capabilities to ensure product reliability and performance. Its global customer service network and ability to meet diverse client specifications provide competitive advantages, enabling it to serve leading semiconductor manufacturers and contribute to the domestic semiconductor supply chain localization.
